_doc: Room recipes, by room key (dune-run --rooms). defaults apply to every room, with or without its own recipe (the look comes from style.json: game, then location). parts: people and objects painted into the room, redone in close-up (box in low-res pixels). A part may name a character (recipes/cast.json), set its own strength, cond, soften, zoom, seed, margin (crop height / box height, default 1.4) darken (areas [x0, y0, x1, y1, factor] darkened in the close-up's guide only, e.g. a grey rifle beside a grey leg) and feather (soft edge of the paste-back, HD pixels; wide for a patch of floor) and close (fills warm gaps such as faces and hands inside the selected outline, in pixels). context (false: the part is drawn from the pixel art alone, not over the room's rendering); same_as copies another part's recipe; copy_of reuses another part's HD result for the same sprite drawn again (same box size; flip for a mirrored copy). An emblem part (emblem: NAME, a vector master NAME.svg in WORK/emblems or recipes/emblems) paints out the room's own version (red pixels in the box) and draws the master in the box in the original's colour (flip for a mirrored one); material adds an optional light pass describing the surface. detail: a pass over the whole room after the close-up parts (enlarged by scale, repainted in tiles at low strength), so the room is as crisp as the parts and they do not pop out; emblems come after it.

defaults.negative: person, people, human figure, statue, out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, blurry, soft focus, haze, cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise
